# Roblox Creator Documentation
> Documentation for building experiences on Roblox.

## Art
- [Surface appearance](/docs/en-us/art/modeling/surface-appearance.md): PBR textures on MeshParts with SurfaceAppearance.
- [Texture specifications](https://create.roblox.com/docs/en-us/art/modeling/texture-specifications.md): Size limits for textures.

## Environment
- [Atmosphere](/docs/en-us/environment/atmosphere.md): Density, haze and glare.
- [Global wind](/docs/en-us/environment/global-wind.md): Wind for grass, particles and clouds.
- [Lighting](/docs/en-us/environment/lighting.md): Global lighting and technologies.

## Engine API
- [SurfaceAppearance](/docs/en-us/reference/engine/classes/SurfaceAppearance.md): Class reference.
